messages:
Emma (Partnerships): Heads-up — ACME Cloud + NitroHW want to do a joint marketplace listing + launch on 4/15. We need to confirm what security artifacts we can surface publicly vs what goes into the partner-only bundle. Also need a plan for a short press embargo. Link to partner checklist: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/checklists/joint-listing

Raj (Security): Thanks. Quick notes: SOC2 Type II report is fine to reference publicly (summary + logo), full report must be gated. Pen test: marketplace wants a pen within last 12 months. If NitroHW has firmware attestation, we need the HSM/KMS attestation and telemetry redaction statement.

Luis (Legal): Agree with Raj. For the SOC2 we usually publish an SOC snapshot + statement of controls. Full report requires an NDA or secure transfer. For the press embargo we need partner signoff on the redacted artifact language by 4/1.

Sarah (Marketplace): FYI marketplace listing requires: public control summary, link to attestation (if public), and upload of sealed artifact to our partner portal. The portal supports S3 presigned uploads or direct secure portal upload. Prefer portal for auditability.

Maya (Engineering): If we go portal, we can require KMS-wrapped uploads and store object metadata with `x-redwood-source: partner-bundle`. ETA to enable the extra metadata is 2 days if we have the exact file spec.

Emma (Partnerships): Actionable asks: (1) Raj — can you confirm minimal redaction rules for firmware logs and telemetry by EOD Fri? (2) Luis — prepare a short NDA template for NitroHW access to full SOC and pen artifacts, target ready 3/28. (3) Maya + Sarah — decide portal vs presigned by 3/26 so partners can upload before 4/1. Also we need an embargo lift plan for 4/15 09:00 PST.

Raj (Security): Minimal redaction: remove PII, IP addresses in telemetry, and exact firmware hashes if they can be used to enumerate devices. Keep control narratives intact. I'll post a 1-pager with examples in #eng-security and link it here.

Luis (Legal): NDA draft created: `Redwood-Partner-Artifact-Access-2026.docx`. I will attach to the partner packet and share via portal link. Side note: include a clause that press embargo only lifts after joint comms release.

Maya (Engineering): Portal option wins from my side for traceability. If partners cannot use portal, presigned S3 with one-time token + TTL 48h is fallback. Will add upload manifest (filename, SHA256, artifact-type) and enforce content-type checks.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Marketplace listings with SOC2 references must include `soc_summary.txt` and `attestation_statement.pdf` in the partner bundle. See policy: https://redwood.internal/compliance/marketplace-soc-guidance

Sarah (Marketplace): Great. I'll build the listing template and prefill marketplace fields. Emma — can you own partner comms timeline and confirm partner signoffs by 3/31?

Emma (Partnerships): Yep — I'll coordinate. Final ask: partners asked about HSM attestation wording — Raj/Luis, can we agree on a 2-line public-safe phrase like: "Hardware security modules used for key management meet vendor attestation standards; detailed attestation available to partners under NDA"? If ok I'll add to listing.

Raj (Security): That phrasing is good.

Luis (Legal): Acceptable. Keep it high level.

Emma (Partnerships): Awesome — next check-in Thursday 3/26 11am PT. I'll post calendar invite and tag ACME/Nitro contacts. :raised_hands:
